contracts.boundary: Only structured numeric HTTP statuses carry HTTP-status evidence. Pi error text with an explicit 429 remains heuristic and is applied at final settlement with a visible short provider pause; background probe inference is also identified visibly. Incidental numbers do not become billing or rate-limit signals.
contracts.assertions: Real Pi HTTP 200 stream errors using 429 followed by a space or colon produce an inferred warning and bounded provider pause in v1 Auto and physical and v2 Auto. Actual HTTP 429 and native successful retry controls pass. Registered-hook tests exercise both background probe text formats and failed provider persistence. Direct normalization tests verify text provenance, structured-status precedence, and incidental-number controls. A delayed background cooldown write cannot notify after session shutdown, and a throwing optional warning cannot block saving a healthy alternate.

boundaryTest.name: temporarily avoids a provider for inferred 429 (1, spoofed-rate-limit-space, auto)

invariant.name: keeps every status-like 429 text heuristic while explicit quota codes retain allowance meaning

fault.exception: Before the fix, a real Pi HTTP 200 stream containing 429 followed by a space created a provider cooldown without the inferred-text warning; a temporary real-Pi control reproduced that boundary.
